source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
title: Injured — currently in Kathmandu hospitals (NDRRMA)
body: NDRRMA published a list of people injured in the Rasuwa Bhotekoshi / Trishuli floods who are currently receiving treatment in various Kathmandu hospitals. Open the official NDRRMA page to search the list. This site links to NDRRMA; we do not copy names or case details.
